public_source_audit.source: Godin & Thivierge, PLOS Computational Biology 2026, DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719, published 2026-08-25
observations: The live PLOS article still exposes S1 Code at DOI 10.1371/journal.pcbi.1014719.s002 and states that SPLiT combines online Oja tracking with normalized LMS in intrinsic coordinates.
Read-only recovery of the ZIP remained blocked in this invocation; no source-exact S8/S11/S12 execution was performed.

The paper itself attributes advantages under constrained low-rank activity to learning in a compact well-conditioned feature space while acknowledging that intrinsic-coordinate or pseudoinverse formulations can mitigate full-space conditioning issues.
public_source_audit.scope: Paper inspection plus bounded source-derived synthetic controls; not an exact reproduction of the authors' recurrent network or supporting code.

bounded_audit.status: structured off-manifold signal and transient-rank-collapse boundary test; non-reproduction
bounded_audit.purpose: Test where fixed-k intrinsic restriction stops being beneficial because useful or high-variance signal lies outside the tracked manifold, and where temporary covariance-rank loss makes adaptive tracking lag behind full-space regression.

design.structured_fourth_direction: fixed vector orthogonal to both endpoint manifolds, carrying an AR(1) scalar s with observation amplitude a
design.target: normalized linear readout of z plus gamma*s
design.tracker: normalized PAST/Oja-like O(Nk) update with QR/Procrustes alignment
design.decoders: same-class RLS for tracked k=3, tracked k=4 and full N=30
design.rank_collapse: third latent coordinate multiplied by 0.02 during a middle window, then restored; 20 paired seeds

structured_signal_results.interpretation: A fixed k=3 bottleneck is beneficial only while the discarded directions are genuinely nuisance. Even an irrelevant fourth structured component with sufficient variance (a=0.2 to 0.35) can pull the adaptive basis away from the task subspace enough to erase or reverse the denoising benefit. When the fourth component is target-relevant, full-space RLS can dominate unless the intrinsic model's dimension budget expands to k=4; even k=4 loses to full space when the useful fourth signal is weakly observed but heavily weighted in the target, because tracking/sample efficiency then becomes the limiting factor.

rank_collapse_results.interpretation: Long enough transient rank collapse creates a recovery cost for adaptive subspace tracking: after a 40% trajectory collapse window the tracked model is significantly worse than full RLS immediately after the missing mode returns, while shorter 10% collapse still favors intrinsic tracking. The basis eventually realigns, so this is a plasticity/recovery-time boundary rather than permanent failure.

runtime_probe.environment: current Python/Numpy runtime; wall-clock microbenchmark, not portable hardware performance
runtime_probe.interpretation: Python overhead makes full RLS faster at very small N, but the O(N^2) update overtakes the O(Nk) tracker+intrinsic path in this implementation between N=60 and N=120 and grows rapidly thereafter. These timings are implementation-specific and are evidence only for scaling direction, not absolute deployment latency.

bounded_audit.algebraic_control: For a fixed orthonormal basis U, regression using an ambient rank-k pseudoinverse restricted to span(U) is algebraically equivalent to regression in coordinates c=U^T x followed by ambient weight Uw. Therefore a 'matched effective-rank full-space pseudoinverse' is not an independent mechanism unless its subspace estimator or update semantics differ; the causal comparison should focus on subspace estimation/adaptation and dimension selection, not coordinate representation alone.
limits: Synthetic linear-latent model and generic tracker; not source-exact SPLiT/Oja recurrent dynamics.
Structured fourth direction is deliberately simplified and fixed; real useful off-manifold structure can be nonlinear, transient or task-dependent.
The k=4 result shows that dimension selection matters, but k itself was manually supplied rather than inferred online.
Rank-collapse severity is defined by one latent variance suppression schedule and should not be generalized to all covariance degeneracy.
Runtime is a local NumPy microbenchmark with no optimized low-rank kernels or hardware-specific RLS implementation.

candidate_update.positive_scope: When dominant off-manifold directions are nuisance and the tracked rank contains all task-relevant factors, adaptive intrinsic regression can denoise and reduce state/compute cost. The benefit is strongest under ambient nuisance, large N/k and limited samples.
candidate_update.negative_boundary: Fixed-rank intrinsic restriction can fail when structured off-manifold signal is task-relevant, when irrelevant structured variance displaces a weak task mode, or after sufficiently long temporary rank collapse before the tracker re-acquires the restored dimension. A matched rank-k pseudoinverse in ambient coordinates is not mechanistically distinct from intrinsic regression at fixed U.
